description: This Java class 'ByteUtil' provides utility methods for manipulating and converting byte arrays, including functions for interpreting bytes as unsigned or signed integers, converting to float, matching bit masks, copying byte lists, and searching for byte patterns within larger byte arrays.

classes.name: ByteUtil
classes.description: A utility class for byte array manipulation, conversions, and pattern matching in Java.

methods.name: asUnsignedInt
methods.description: Converts a byte or byte array to an unsigned integer representation.

methods.name: asSignedInt
methods.description: Converts a byte array to a signed integer.

methods.name: asByte
methods.description: Converts an integer to a byte.

methods.name: asFloat
methods.description: Converts a segment of a byte array into a float, given an offset and length.

methods.name: asInt
methods.description: Converts a byte to an integer.

methods.name: matchOnes
methods.description: Checks if the bits specified in the mask are all set to 1 in the byte.

methods.name: matchZeroes
methods.description: Checks if the bits specified in the mask are all zero in the byte.

methods.name: byteListToBytes
methods.description: Copies a List of Byte objects into a byte array.

methods.name: indexOfBytes
methods.description: Finds the index of a pattern byte array within a larger byte array.

methods.name: computeFailure
methods.description: Computes the failure function used in pattern matching (KMP Algorithm).
